description: This is a test class for SerializedObjectDAO, testing serialization and persistence of Program objects in the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: SerializedObjectDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing SerializedObjectDAO implementations within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize the DAO and load initial data.

methods.name: getObject_shouldReturnTheSavedObject
methods.description: Test retrieving a Program object by ID.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid_shouldReturnTheSavedObject
methods.description: Test retrieving a Program object by UUID.

methods.name: saveObject_shouldSaveThePassedObjectIfSupported
methods.description: Test saving a Program object supported by the DAO.

methods.name: saveObject_shouldSetAuditableFieldsBeforeSerializing
methods.description: Ensure audit fields are set before serializing and saving.

methods.name: saveObject_shouldThrowAnExceptionIfObjectNotSupported
methods.description: Test exception thrown when trying to save unsupported object types.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnAllSavedObjectsOfThePassedType
methods.description: Verify retrieval of all saved Program objects.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnOnlyNonRetiredObjectsOfThePassedTypeIfNotIncludeRetired
methods.description: Test filtering of non-retired Program objects.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnAllSavedObjectsWithTheGivenTypeAndExactName
methods.description: Retrieve objects matching an exact name.

methods.name: getAllObjects_shouldReturnAllSavedObjectsWithTheGivenTypeAndPartialName
methods.description: Retrieve objects matching a partial name.

methods.name: purgeObject_shouldDeleteTheObjectWithThePassedId
methods.description: Test deletion of a Program object by ID.
